title: FPS Optimized
description: FPS Optimized is a client-side modpack focused on one goal: maximum performance. It is designed to deliver the highest possible FPS and the smoothest gameplay experience by including only performance-enhancing mods.
body:
# 🚀 FPS Optimized | Zero-Bloat Performance

**FPS Optimized** is a lean, high-speed modpack built for one reason: to deliver the maximum possible frame rates. We’ve stripped away the "quality of life" clutter and focused entirely on engine optimization, memory efficiency, and hardware utilization.

---

### 🔥 Core Performance Stack
* **Rendering Overhaul:** Replaces the vanilla engine with **Sodium/Embeddium** for massive FPS gains.
* **Memory Efficiency:** Uses **FerriteCore** to drastically reduce RAM usage by optimizing model and block state storage.
* **Logic Optimization:** **Lithium** improves game physics, AI, and tick-speed to eliminate stuttering.
* **Entity Culling:** Stops your PC from wasting resources rendering hidden mobs and chests.
* **Immediate Rendering:** Uses **ImmediatelyFast** to accelerate the rendering of text, particles, and entities.

### 🎯 Why This Pack?
* **No Unnecessary Bloat:** No mini-maps, no inventory tweaks, no extra HUDs.
* **Potato PC Friendly:** Specifically designed to make Minecraft playable on low-end laptops and older hardware.
* **Clean & Stable:** Focuses on the most stable optimization mods to ensure your game doesn't crash during a match.

---

### 🛠️ Quick Info
* **Platform:** Fabric
* **Target:** 2GB - 4GB RAM (Runs great on low-memory systems!)
* **Focus:** Pure Speed & Stability

---

> **Note:** For the absolute best results, ensure your GPU drivers are up to date and your "Graphics" settings are set to 'Fast'.
